notes: First-pass fictional dialogue. Roles remain unnamed until character references/backstories arrive. Timings are seconds from departure; no voice recordings yet.

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: That pothole's still there. They fixed everything except the road.

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: Slow down. This car has to get us home as well.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: What did the caller actually say?

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: The temple caretaker. He heard people shouting inside. Wouldn't go back through the gate.

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: Three of us for a noise complaint. On market day, too.

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: He called twice. The second time he just kept asking how far away we were.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Does anyone still live up there?

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: Just the caretaker. My grandmother used to take us there when we were small.

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: They said you could hear the bell from the village. Even when nobody rang it.

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: Your grandmother told you that so you'd behave.

lines.speaker: DRIVER
lines.text: It worked. I didn't like staying after dark.

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: The turn's just ahead. He's supposed to meet us by the bridge.

lines.speaker: FRONT PASSENGER
lines.text: There it is. Let's find him first, then we go in together.
